title: Classifier eval row
description: One labelled example for the artifact-need classifier (the 'bridge' decision). Given a plain request, which product-truth artifacts must be drafted, and which agent builds it. `outcome` must be consistent with `expected{}` (validated by scripts/validate_product_truth.py).

outcome.description: Derived from expected{}: TTT=full-set, FTT=mockup+data, FFT=mockup-only, FTF=mock-data-only, FFF=none. Other combos are flagged by the validator.

builds_with.description: The existing leafcutter agent(s) that build the result — the bridge to today's system.

decision.description: Optional: whether the request creates a NEW artifact or EXTENDS an existing one (the store's add-vs-create protocol).

extends.description: Optional: artifact id this request extends (when decision=extend).

ac.description: Optional back-reference to the acceptance-criterion id this row exercises (bidirectional traceability to the AC store). Ignored by the scorer.
